# Programs No named program. Bumble posts single intern roles: software engineering (summer 2026), a Gen Z research internship (summer 2021) and influencer marketing (fall 2021)


*Last updated: November 2026*


No Bumble internship is open as of November 2026. Bumble's[Ashby job board](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/bumbleinc) listed three roles on November 13, 2026, one in London and two in the US, and none was an internship. The last intern role we can document was a summer 2026 Software Engineering Intern in Austin, Texas: a startup.jobs copy of the posting is dated September 5, 2025 and now reads "no longer available". Bumble didn't publish that role's open or close date on its own pages, and a September 8, 2026 archive of its board showed 24 roles and no summer 2027 internship. So the summer 2027 open date is unknown. In plain words: if Bumble hires a summer 2027 class, you'd apply in the months before and intern in summer 2027, and the only way to catch it is to watch the board.


---


## What Is a Bumble Internship?


A Bumble internship is a short role at Bumble Inc., the Austin-based company behind the Bumble dating app, Bumble For Friends (BFF) and Badoo. Bumble doesn't run a named internship program. It posts single intern roles on its Ashby board when a team needs one, and its[careers page](https://team.bumble.com/en_GB) doesn't mention internships at all. Roles we could document: a summer 2026 Software Engineering Intern in Austin (startup.jobs copy), a summer 2021 remote research internship on a Gen Z think-tank project (Bumble's own posting, archived), and a fall 2021 Influencer Marketing Intern at the Austin headquarters, described by the intern on InternQueen. Bumble's stated mission is "To bring the world closer to love". One naming note: Bumble Bizz is the app's networking mode, not a Bumble job board, so searching it won't show Bumble's own internships.


## When Do Bumble Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Bumble doesn't publish an internship calendar, and its intern roles have been irregular. The 2021 research internship was posted by June 14, 2021 for a start on June 28, per an archived copy of Bumble's careers site. For summer 2026, a startup.jobs copy of the Software Engineering Intern posting is dated September 5, 2025; Bumble's own open and close dates aren't public. A September 8, 2026 archive of Bumble's board showed 24 roles and no internship, and today's board has none either. That leaves the summer 2027 open date unknown, so the timeline below tells you what to set up and when to check, not when to expect a date.


Now · November 2026 YOU ARE HERE


Nothing is open. Bumble's Ashby board lists three roles and no internship. Bookmark the board, follow Bumble Inc. on LinkedIn, where it posts company news, and put a weekly board check in your calendar.


Build proof while you wait: the[SQL & Database Architecture Externship with Breaking Games](https://www.extern.com/externships/breaking-games-sql-database-architecture-nov-2026-2) or the[BeReal Product Management](https://www.extern.com/externships/bereal-product-management-externship-nov-2026-2) Externship gives you a finished project to show.


December 2026 to February 2027


Get your resume and one project link ready, and keep checking weekly. If you want a software role, have a project you can walk through line by line, since Bumble says it will ask what you actually did.


Any week in 2027


Watch for summer 2027 roles. This isn't a projected window: Bumble's last software intern posting was dated September 2025 on a mirror site, and nothing has appeared on its board since. A role could show up at any point, or not at all.


Within weeks of applying


If a role opens: Bumble's own interview page says it may give take-home tasks and that some software engineering interviews include an AI collaboration exercise, which it tells you about in advance.


Summer 2027


The internship itself, if Bumble hires a class. The summer 2026 software role was based in Austin; Bumble hasn't published pay or length for it.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


We can't call Bumble's internship rolling or give a hard deadline, because no Bumble intern posting we could open states either. What we can see points to apply early. Bumble posts one requisition at a time, not a large program, so a single role may be the only door that year. Ashby removes closed postings from the board, so a role you miss leaves no trace there. Check the board weekly and apply within days of an intern role going up.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Bumble's own pages don't list intern requirements, and its 2026 posting survives only on a mirror site. Here's what we can say.


• **Who it's for:** college students outside Bumble. The summer 2026 role and the 2021 roles were open to outside applicants.


• **Location:** the summer 2026 software role was in Austin, Texas. The 2021 research internship was fully remote.


• **Field:** the 2021 research posting asked for background in "Design, Product, Analytics, and Cognitive Science". Requirements for the 2026 role aren't published on Bumble's own pages.


• **GPA:** not published.


• **Work authorization and sponsorship:** not published on Bumble's own pages. Ask the recruiter early if you'll need sponsorship.


### Is the GPA a Hard Cutoff?


Bumble doesn't publish a GPA minimum for interns, and we found no applicant reports that mention one. Its interview page puts the weight on your real experience and how you reason through problems. Read the requirements on the next posting, and lead with work you can explain in detail.

Firms recruit on campus in tiers. We match you against admits from schools like yours.

#### Is your major computer science, software engineering, data science or electrical engineering?


Almost every software intern in our data studied one of these. Other majors get in, but the coursework has to show elsewhere.

Software, data, IT, engineering or a research lab. Any size of company counts.

## What Is the Bumble Application and Interview Process Like?


Bumble doesn't publish an intern-specific process. Its interview page, written for all candidates, sets these rules.


1. **Apply on Ashby.** Roles are posted one at a time on Bumble's board; there's no general intern application.


2. **Prepare with AI if you like.** Bumble says you can use AI to research the company, practice and polish your written application, but you must be ready to discuss everything you list.


3. **Live interviews without AI help.** Bumble asks candidates not to use AI to generate or refine answers in real time, and says "I'm not sure, but here's how I'd approach it" is a fine answer.


4. **AI exercise for some software roles.** Some software engineering interviews include an AI collaboration exercise, and Bumble tells you beforehand.


5. **Take-home tasks.** Each brief says whether AI is allowed; if it is, Bumble asks you to explain how you used it.


Bumble publishes no intern interview questions, timing or acceptance rate.


### What Students on Reddit Say


We found no Reddit threads from students who interned at Bumble. Searches for Bumble internships return threads about Bumble Bizz, the app's networking mode, and none is about working at the company, so we haven't quoted any.


## How Do You Stand Out for a Bumble Internship?


First, be ready before a role appears. Bumble posts single intern roles without notice, so have a finished resume and a project link waiting. Second, pick a track. Past roles covered software engineering, Gen Z research and influencer marketing, so show work in the one you want, such as a deployed app, a short user study or a campaign you ran. Third, know your own work cold. Bumble's interview page says it will ask what you actually did and wants to hear how you think, not polished AI answers. Bumble doesn't publish an applicant count, class size or conversion rate, so there's no number to benchmark against.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Bumble internship?


No. The summer 2026 Software Engineering Intern role in Austin is closed, and a startup.jobs copy dated September 5, 2025 now reads "no longer available". Nothing is open as of November 2026, and Bumble hasn't said when or whether a summer 2027 role will post, so check its Ashby board weekly.


### When do Bumble internship applications open?


Bumble doesn't publish a date. A startup.jobs copy of the summer 2026 software posting is dated September 5, 2025, but Bumble's own board showed no summer 2027 internship on September 8 or November 13, 2026. So the next open date is unknown. Check the board weekly and apply the week a role appears.


### Does Bumble pay its interns?


Bumble hasn't published intern pay on its own pages for any role we found, including the summer 2026 software internship and the 2021 research internship. We won't quote figures from salary aggregators. If a summer 2027 role posts, check the posting itself for a pay range before you apply.


### What kinds of internships does Bumble offer?


Bumble posts single roles, not a program. The ones we could document were a summer 2026 Software Engineering Intern in Austin, a six-week remote summer 2021 research internship on a Gen Z think-tank project, and a fall 2021 Influencer Marketing Intern at the Austin headquarters.


### Are Bumble internships remote?


It depends on the role. The summer 2026 software internship was based in Austin, Texas, and listed as on-site by startup.jobs. The 2021 research internship was fully remote. Bumble's hubs are Austin, New York and London, and this guide covers US roles only, so check the location on the next posting.


### Can I find a Bumble internship on Bumble Bizz?


No. Bumble Bizz is the app's networking mode for meeting professionals, not Bumble's hiring system. Bumble's own roles, interns included, are posted on its Ashby job board, linked from the careers page at team.bumble.com. That's the only place to apply for a Bumble internship.


### What is the Bumble interview process like?


Bumble doesn't publish an intern process, but its interview page for all candidates says you may use AI to prepare, not during live interviews. Some software engineering interviews include an AI collaboration exercise, announced in advance, and take-home briefs say whether AI is allowed. Expect questions about what you actually did.


### Do Bumble interns get full-time offers?


Bumble doesn't publish a return-offer or conversion rate, or how many interns it hires. Its roles are posted one at a time, so there's no standing pipeline we can describe. If a summer 2027 role opens, ask about full-time paths during your interviews.


Bookmark Bumble's Ashby board and check it weekly. While you wait, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you a finished software, research or marketing project to show a recruiter.
